model_output.verdict: A staff accountant with a clear progression at Rivermark, but too little detail about the close and audit.
write_up: You’ve moved from Accounts Payable Clerk to Staff Accountant at Rivermark Building Supply, and your resume points clearly toward staff accounting. It’s common to list accounting duties this way, but the close and audit work sound much like other staff accountant resumes. A recruiter has to guess what you handle within them.

The journal entries and account reconciliations line is your best model: it names two concrete pieces of work rather than leaving the reader with a general responsibility. Your experience sits above education, and the move into accounting is easy to follow.

Let’s start with the month-end close line. Add the tasks you handle, then show what you contribute to the annual audit and what accounts payable work you take on when needed. Use details you can stand behind; you don’t need to put a number on every line.
